description: This file contains utility functions for handling DTensor parameters in PyTorch's distributed data parallel (DDP) context, including functions to reconstruct, localize, and transform DTensors for compatibility with DDP.

methods.name: _get_submodule_n_params
methods.description: Retrieves a submodule and parameter path from a given module based on a dot-separated path.

methods.name: _update_module_param
methods.description: Updates module parameters by replacing existing parameters with new ones.

methods.name: _reconstruct_dtensor
methods.description: Reconstructs DTensor parameters from local tensors within a module.

methods.name: _localize_dtensor
methods.description: Converts DTensor parameters to local tensors, optionally ignoring specified parameters.

methods.name: _pre_dp_module_transform
methods.description: Prepares a module for data parallelism by converting DTensors to local tensors and registering hooks for tensor transformations during forward passes.
